chapterInfo.content:
7
Yerusalem amanehunu
1 # 2 Ah 15.37; 16.5 Na ɛbaa sɛ Usia ba Yotam ba Ahas a ɔyɛ Yuda hene berɛ so no, Siriahene Resin ne Israelhene Peka a ɔyɛ Remalia ba baa Yerusalem, sɛ wɔne no rebɛko, na wɔantumi no. 2Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Dawid fie sɛ: Siria ne Efraim ayɛ apam. Ɛnna n’akoma ne ne man akoma wosoeɛ, sɛdeɛ kwaeɛ mu nnua wosoɔ wɔ mframa anim.
3Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia sɛ: Firi kɔhyia Ahas, wo ne wo ba Sear-yasub,#7.3 SEAR-YASUB: Asekyerɛ ne sɛ: Nkaeɛ no bɛsan aba. wɔ atifi tadeɛ suka no a ɛkyerɛ ntomasifoɔ afuo tempɔn soɔ no ano, 4#Yes 30.15 na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ yie na yɛ komm, nsuro, na mma w’akoma nntu, nnyentia mmienu a ɛfiri wisie yi nti, Resin ne Siria ne Remalia ba no abufuhyeɛ no nti. 5Ɛsiane sɛ Siria ne Efraim ne Remalia ba no apam wo tiri so apammɔne sɛ: 6Momma yɛnkɔ Yuda so na yɛnkɔha no, na yɛnni so mfa, na yɛnsi Tabeel ba no hene wɔ mu, nti: 7Sɛɛ na AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ: Ɛrennyina na ɛremma mu,
8na Siria tiri ne Damasko,
na Damasko tiri ne Resin.
(Na ɛha mfirinhyia aduosia nnum no, wɔbɛsɛe Efraim na anyɛ ɔman bio.)
9 # 2 Be 20.20 Efraim tiri ne Samaria,
na Samaria tiri ne Remalia ba no:
Sɛ morennye nni a,
nokorɛ morennyina.
Imanuel nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ
10Na AWURADE toaa so ka kyerɛɛ Ahas sɛ: 11Bisa AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hɔ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, ma no nsiane nkɔ sɛ Asamando, anaa ɛnkorɔn sɛ ɔsoro! 12Na Ahas se: Meremmisa, na merensɔ AWURADE menhwɛ. 13Ɛnna ɔse: Dawid fie, montie ɛ! Ha a moha nnipa yi, ɛnnɔɔso mmaa mo, sɛ mobɛha me Nyankopɔn nso? 14#Mika 5.3; Mat 1.23; Yes 8.8, 10; 9.6 Enti AWURADE no ara bɛma mo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ: Hwɛ, ababaa bi bɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabanin, na wato no din Imanuel#7.14 Asekyerɛ ne sɛ: Onyankopɔn ne yɛn wɔ hɔ.. 15#Yes 7.21-22 Nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne ɛwoɔ na ɔbɛdie, berɛ a ɔhunu bɔne na ɔkyire, na papa na ɔfa no. 16#Yes 8.4 Na abarimaa no nnya nhunuu bɔne kyire ne papa fa no, asase a wosuro n’ahemfo baanu anim no bɛyɛ amamfo.
Asotwe a ɛnam Asiriafoɔ so ba
17AWURADE de nna bi bɛba wo ne wo man, ne w’agya fie so, nna a ɛmmaa da firi berɛ a Efraim te firii Yuda ho no: Ɛne Asiriahene.
18Na ɛbɛba sɛ ɛda no, AWURADE bɛbɔ hwerɛma afrɛ anwansena a ɔwɔ Misraim asuasu awieeɛ no, ne wowa a ɔwɔ Asiria asase soɔ no, 19na wɔn nyinaa aba abɛsisi mmonhwa a ɛsiane kuronkuron, ne abotan mpaepaeɛ mu, ne nkasɛɛ ne ɛserɛ nyinaa so.
20Ɛda no ara na AWURADE de yiwan a wɔabɔ no paa Asuogya hɔnom a ɛne Asiriahene, no bɛyi etire ne nan ho nwi,#7.20 bɛyi … nan ho nwi: Asekyerɛ ne sɛ: Yi ase nwi. na ayi bɔdwesɛ nso.
21Na ɛda no, obi bɛyɛne nantwiburuwa ne nnwan mmienu bi, 22na nufosuo a ɔbɛnya no dodoɔ nti, ɔbɛdi nufosuo ani sradeɛ, na nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne ɛwoɔ ara na wɔn a wɔbɛka asase no soɔ nyinaa bɛdie.
23Na ɛbɛba sɛ ɛda no, baabiara a bobe apem a kane ɛdi nnwetɛbena apem wɔ no bɛdane nkasɛɛ ne nnɛnkyɛnse ara nko. 24Agyan ne tadua na wɔde bɛba hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ asase no nyinaa ayɛ nkasɛɛ ne nnɛnkyɛnse ara nko; 25na mmepɔ a anka wɔde asɔ dɔ soɔ nyinaa no, nwerɛ ne nkasɛɛ ho hu nti wɔrenkɔ hɔ bio, na wɔbɛgyaa anantwie akɔ so, na nnwan atiatia so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɛbaa sɛ Usia ba Yotam ba Ahas a ɔyɛ Yuda hene berɛ so no, Siriahene Resin ne Israelhene Peka a ɔyɛ Remalia ba baa Yerusalem, sɛ wɔne no rebɛko, na wɔantumi no. Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Dawid fie sɛ: Siria ne Efraim ayɛ apam. Ɛnna n’akoma ne ne man akoma wosoeɛ, sɛdeɛ kwaeɛ mu nnua wosoɔ wɔ mframa anim.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia sɛ: Firi kɔhyia Ahas, wo ne wo ba Sear-yasub, wɔ atifi tadeɛ suka no a ɛkyerɛ ntomasifoɔ afuo tempɔn soɔ no ano, na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ yie na yɛ komm, nsuro, na mma w’akoma nntu, nnyentia mmienu a ɛfiri wisie yi nti, Resin ne Siria ne Remalia ba no abufuhyeɛ no nti. Ɛsiane sɛ Siria ne Efraim ne Remalia ba no apam wo tiri so apammɔne sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ Yuda so na yɛnkɔha no, na yɛnni so mfa, na yɛnsi Tabeel ba no hene wɔ mu, nti: Sɛɛ na AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ: Ɛrennyina na ɛremma mu,
na Siria tiri ne Damasko,
na Damasko tiri ne Resin.
(Na ɛha mfirinhyia aduosia nnum no, wɔbɛsɛe Efraim na anyɛ ɔman bio.)
Efraim tiri ne Samaria,
na Samaria tiri ne Remalia ba no:
Sɛ morennye nni a,
nokorɛ morennyina.

Na AWURADE toaa so ka kyerɛɛ Ahas sɛ: Bisa AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hɔ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, ma no nsiane nkɔ sɛ Asamando, anaa ɛnkorɔn sɛ ɔsoro! Na Ahas se: Meremmisa, na merensɔ AWURADE menhwɛ. Ɛnna ɔse: Dawid fie, montie ɛ! Ha a moha nnipa yi, ɛnnɔɔso mmaa mo, sɛ mobɛha me Nyankopɔn nso? Enti AWURADE no ara bɛma mo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ: Hwɛ, ababaa bi bɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabanin, na wato no din Imanuel. Nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne ɛwoɔ na ɔbɛdie, berɛ a ɔhunu bɔne na ɔkyire, na papa na ɔfa no. Na abarimaa no nnya nhunuu bɔne kyire ne papa fa no, asase a wosuro n’ahemfo baanu anim no bɛyɛ amamfo.

AWURADE de nna bi bɛba wo ne wo man, ne w’agya fie so, nna a ɛmmaa da firi berɛ a Efraim te firii Yuda ho no: Ɛne Asiriahene.
Na ɛbɛba sɛ ɛda no, AWURADE bɛbɔ hwerɛma afrɛ anwansena a ɔwɔ Misraim asuasu awieeɛ no, ne wowa a ɔwɔ Asiria asase soɔ no, na wɔn nyinaa aba abɛsisi mmonhwa a ɛsiane kuronkuron, ne abotan mpaepaeɛ mu, ne nkasɛɛ ne ɛserɛ nyinaa so.
Ɛda no ara na AWURADE de yiwan a wɔabɔ no paa Asuogya hɔnom a ɛne Asiriahene, no bɛyi etire ne nan ho nwi, na ayi bɔdwesɛ nso.
Na ɛda no, obi bɛyɛne nantwiburuwa ne nnwan mmienu bi, na nufosuo a ɔbɛnya no dodoɔ nti, ɔbɛdi nufosuo ani sradeɛ, na nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne ɛwoɔ ara na wɔn a wɔbɛka asase no soɔ nyinaa bɛdie.
Na ɛbɛba sɛ ɛda no, baabiara a bobe apem a kane ɛdi nnwetɛbena apem wɔ no bɛdane nkasɛɛ ne nnɛnkyɛnse ara nko. Agyan ne tadua na wɔde bɛba hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ asase no nyinaa ayɛ nkasɛɛ ne nnɛnkyɛnse ara nko; na mmepɔ a anka wɔde asɔ dɔ soɔ nyinaa no, nwerɛ ne nkasɛɛ ho hu nti wɔrenkɔ hɔ bio, na wɔbɛgyaa anantwie akɔ so, na nnwan atiatia so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
